class.name: GrpcClient
class.brief_description: Generic gRPC client with raw protobuf and reflection-driven JSON calls.

method.name: call_async
method.description: Starts an asynchronous call. The returned [GrpcCall] emits [signal GrpcCall.completed] on the main thread. Keep a reference to it until it completes.

method.name: close
method.description: Cancels active calls and forgets cached reflection descriptors.

method.name: close_server
method.description: Alias of [method close] for compatibility with the Go GDExtension.

method.name: connect_server
method.description: Configures the target and returns a JSON envelope ([code]{"ok":true}[/code] or [code]{"ok":false,"error":"..."}[/code]), matching the Go GDExtension. The connection itself is opened per call.

method.name: connect_to_host
method.description: Configures the target from [code]host:port[/code] (IPv6 in brackets is accepted). [param server_name] selects the TLS SNI name; it defaults to the host.

method.name: invoke
method.description: Blocking unary call with raw protobuf bytes. Returns an empty array on failure; inspect [method last_status].

method.name: invoke_json
method.description: Blocking unary call using protobuf JSON. Returns [code]{"ok":true,"data":...}[/code] or [code]{"ok":false,"error":"...","code":N}[/code]. Descriptors are fetched once with gRPC server reflection and cached.

method.name: invoke_server_stream
method.description: Blocking server-streaming call with raw protobuf bytes. Messages are returned as consecutive 4-byte big-endian length frames.

method.name: invoke_server_stream_json
method.description: Blocking server-streaming call with protobuf JSON. Returns [code]{"ok":true,"data":[..., ...]}[/code].

method.name: last_status
method.description: Returns the status of the last blocking call as JSON: [code]ok[/code], [code]code[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]message[/code], [code]http_status[/code], [code]headers[/code] and [code]trailers[/code].

method.name: open_stream
method.description: Opens a bidirectional or client-streaming call. [param timeout_ms] of [code]0[/code] means no deadline.

constants.constant: The client sent an invalid argument.
The deadline expired before the call completed.
The requested resource was not found.
The system is not in the required state.
An argument is out of range.
The method is not implemented by the server.
